release-item.p: OpenSSL 3 support.
now builds with OpenSSL 3. Deprecation warnings are suppressed, and an unexpected EOF is detected with the error codes that OpenSSL 3 reports.

commit.subject: Replace hrnStorageInfoListCallback() with TEST_STORAGE_LIST() in tests.

Rename strTrunc() to strTruncIdx() and add strTrunc().
Create snapshot when listing contents of a path.

release-item.p: Create snapshot when listing contents of a path.

A path listed without sorting was read while its entries were processed. When files were deleted during the listing, some filesystems skipped files that still existed and the path could not be removed. Listings now always use a snapshot of the path.
Force target-timeline=current when restore type=immediate.

On >= 12 the default target timeline is latest, and recovery could fail when the latest timeline in the repository cannot be reached from the backup. Restore with type=immediate does not change timelines, so it now sets the target timeline to current.
Truncate files during delta restore when they are larger than expected.

Delta restore copied a file from the repository whenever its size differed from the manifest. A larger file is now truncated to the size in the manifest and copied only when its checksum does not match. Files that were only appended to, e.g. logs, are no longer copied.
Disable incremental manifest save when resume=n.
During a backup the manifest is saved periodically for use by resume. These saves are now skipped when resume=n.
Set backup percent complete to zero before copy start.
The progress of a running backup was not reported until the first file was copied. It is now set to zero when copying starts.
Use S3 IsTruncated flag to determine list continuation.

Recent versions of Scality send an empty NextContinuationToken when a list is not truncated, which caused an infinite loop. The IsTruncated flag now determines whether a list continues, and a missing or empty token for a truncated list is an error.
Automatically create version interfaces.
Improve memory usage of mem contexts.
Add FN_NO_RETURN macro.
Add cast to handle compilers (e.g. MSVC) that coerce to signed int.
Fix hard-coded WAL size assertion in walSegmentNext().

release-item.p: Add experimental Meson build.

Meson has simpler syntax and better performance than autoconf/make. It is used for code generation and test builds, and errors on anything but a debug build. Packagers should continue to use autoconf/make.

Fix compile error when DEBUG_EXEC_TIME is defined without DEBUG.
Without DEBUG the ASSERT() that used the start time expanded to nothing, and the unused variable caused a compile error. The check now uses CHECK().
